title: Post-Mythos Cybersecurity: Keep calm and carry on
summary: This article discusses the evolving landscape of cybersecurity in what the author terms the 'post-mythos era', challenging traditional security dogmas and advocating for a pragmatic, calm approach to modern security challenges rather than succumbing to fear-based practices or outdated beliefs.
problem_solved: Addresses the problem of outdated cybersecurity myths and fear-driven practices that no longer effectively protect organizations in modern threat environments.
why_valuable: Provides a refreshing perspective that cuts through cybersecurity hype and encourages practitioners to focus on practical, evidence-based security measures rather than chasing the latest trends or panicking over emerging threats.
